gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-stack-sans-headlin: Stack Sans Headline reads as a plain sans with generous gaps and a deep middle band, drawn in one steady line. And Coming Soon sits above it like a casual scribble, keeping the paragraphs below feeling friendly.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-stack-sans-notch: Stack Sans Notch reads openly, its curves wide enough to peer into, every stroke like cut rod stock and each lowercase word feeling sturdy. Coming Soon earns its keep when it runs big and brief.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-stack-sans-text: Pen-written and personal, then marker-steady. Coming Soon sets a casual tone up top, while Stack Sans Text keeps its curve endings well apart and its big-bodied lowercase easy to follow beneath.

gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-suwannaphum: Suwannaphum is a text serif with a tall x-height and a c as open as a bent paperclip. But Coming Soon's casual, hairline-free handwriting loosens that dignified tone into something personal.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-tiktok-sans: Coming Soon draws every curve with a flat, unswelling line. TikTok Sans, a sans-serif with a tall x-height and a spacious c, then carries a longer passage in a modern, comfortable rhythm.
gen-gf-coming-soon-gf-ubuntu-sans: Coming Soon writes like pen on paper, its o a ring with a constant wall and its lowercase nearly capital height. Ubuntu Sans, a sans-serif with tubular strokes and big lowercase eyes, grounds it.
